_comment: Copy this to .harvest-sources.json and fill in your own paths. That file is gitignored
on purpose: a list of the repositories you run is metadata about your business, and this
repository is public. Environment variables are expanded, so ${REPOS}/name works.
'globs' is optional. Omitted, the harvester looks in the usual places: LESSON.md,
docs/RULES.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Give it explicitly when a repository keeps its
know-how somewhere else - that is the common case, and the one worth checking once.
